reader_sentence: Across GPT-2 small, Pythia-410M and Gemma-2-2B, integrated gradients tracks per-head ablation effects most closely (Spearman ρ ≈ 0.80–0.89, with intervals that don't overlap the next-best method), followed by attribution patching (≈0.6), gradient × input (≈0.45), saliency (≈0.3) and activation magnitude (≈0.15–0.2), and the ranking is the same in all three models.
intended: Integrated gradients matches ablation best on all three models (rank correlation about 0.8 to 0.9), clearly ahead of the next best method, attribution patching (about 0.6).
reason: The summary says integrated gradients is best in all three models (ρ ≈ 0.80–0.89) and clearly ahead of the next-best method, attribution patching (≈0.6); the extra detail on the other methods does not contradict the intended finding.
